summary.text: Kim Schrier is the Democratic U.S. Representative for Washington's 8th Congressional District and won re-election on November 3, 2026. A pediatrician who practiced in Issaquah, she was first elected to Congress in 2018 and, according to her official biography, is the first pediatrician in Congress. She serves on the Energy and Commerce Committee.

paragraphs.text: Schrier grew up the daughter of a public school teacher and an engineer, according to her official biography.

She earned a bachelor's degree in astrophysics from the University of California, Berkeley in 1991 (graduating Phi Beta Kappa, per her official biography) and spent a year at the Environmental Protection Agency before medical school.

She received an M.D. from the University of California, Davis in 1997 and completed a pediatrics residency at Stanford University School of Medicine; her official biography names Lucile Packard Children's Hospital at Stanford.

Schrier began working as a pediatrician in 2000 and spent her career before Congress as a pediatrician in Issaquah. Her official biography says Parents Map Magazine named her Best Pediatrician in the Greater Seattle Area in 2013.
She has type 1 diabetes, diagnosed at age 16, which she cites in her work on healthcare and prescription drug costs.
Schrier was elected to Congress on November 6, 2018, and took office in January 2019; her official biography describes her as the first pediatrician in Congress.

In the 119th Congress she serves on the Energy and Commerce Committee (Health; Energy; and Commerce, Manufacturing, and Trade subcommittees), after earlier terms on the Education and Labor and Agriculture Committees.

Her official site lists her as Chair of the Democratic Doctors Caucus and a Rural Revitalization Working Group chair within the New Democrat Coalition. According to her official biography, she lives in Sammamish with her husband and son.
She won the November 3, 2026 general election with 56.2% of the vote to Spencer Meline's 43.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
